query: What experimental or quasi-experimental designs and causal estimands will identify direct and spillover effects under network interference (cluster randomization, encouragement, exposure modeling)?

response.query: What experimental or quasi-experimental designs and causal estimands will identify direct and spillover effects under network interference (cluster randomization, encouragement, exposure modeling)?
response.answer: Cluster randomization and instrumental variable designs identify direct and spillover effects under network interference. Quasi-experimental methods like difference-in-differences also help assess these effects. Randomized encouragement designs can isolate peer influence.
